evidence_quotes: Vovo tegen verleende omgevingsvergunning voor bouwen fietsbrug, aanleggen fietspad, aanleggen bypass, verkeersbesluit en watervergunning.
rationale: This Dutch preliminary injunction (voorlopige voorziening / vovo) challenges a granted water permit (watervergunning) alongside an environmental/planning permit (omgevingsvergunning) and traffic decision for constructing a bicycle bridge, bicycle path and bypass. Under the protocol rules, a challenge to a Waterwet/watervergunning permit is substantively WATER under both labels and falls within regulatory_permit, with no household water connection refusal or informal settlement issue.
